note: Lassen NF campground on the west shore of Lake Almanor, about 12 miles from Chester. Two areas off Almanor Drive West: Almanor North beside the boat ramp, and Almanor South in the forest about 300 m back from the shore; the group site is across Hwy 89 at the rest area. Almanor South was closed several seasons for hazard-tree removal and reopened in 2026. --Claude
summary: Almanor (Lassen NF): FS page + rec.gov 232246 + Esri. Open (North + group all along; South reopened July 2026 after hazard-tree closure, Reserved in Aug 2026). $18 confirmed (rec.gov + FS), Memorial Day-Labor Day, 2 vehicles/8 people, 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max, vault toilets + water, no hookups. Lakeview kept (North loop only).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept, but only the North loop supports it: rec.gov site points put Almanor South's sites 001-019 280-400 m back from the shore in continuous pine forest (no view); the North loop beside the boat ramp (~40.2203,-121.1765) runs through open scattered pines ~40-60 m from the treeline at the top of the drawdown beach. No per-site data for North (rec.gov lists only 5 unlocated 'Walk-in S&P' sites there), so no on-water upgrade. Suggested evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-26: South loop (rec.gov 001-019) 280-400 m inland in forest; North loop by the ramp ~40-60 m from the high-water treeline through scattered pines -> lakeview from North only'.
Pin 40.21774,-121.17607 is fine: ~75 m north of South site 001 and ~290 m south of the North loop.

Not a split: North (by the ramp) and South (centroid ~40.2163,-121.1780) are ~500 m apart on the same Almanor Drive West; the group camp (GS ALMA, 40.2166,-121.1913) is across Hwy 89, a group site only.
Phone 530-258-2141 and both websites confirmed. Google 'Almanor South Campground' 4.4 (109).
